findings.text: nitpick (non-blocking): R3 reads loom-code's CHANGELOG and accepts any budget-exception line, so the loom-workflow 5.2.0 exception line is not actually gated (pre-existing gate weakness).
findings.fix: Match the exception id to the added mechanism id and read the owning plugin's CHANGELOG.
